messages:
pat-devex: Quick sync: customer reported mismatched behavior between JS and Python SDKs when using function-calling + json_mode + schema validation. TS sample app crashes in staging.

pat-devex: Repro: responses.create with json_mode returns `output_structured.value` as a string in JS bundle, so downstream `validateSchema` fails. Python returns native object.

rachael-sdk: I dug in— we have a browser-targeted stringify fallback that ended up in the Node build via a shared util. That util JSON.stringify's structured outputs to avoid prototype-loss in some old browsers.

rachael-sdk: Proposed short-term fix: export a small helper `sdk.parseJsonModeValue(v)` that attempts JSON.parse if value is a string and `json_mode` is true. Opt-in so we don't change behavior unexpectedly.

omar-runtime: Long-term we should normalize at the runtime edge: start returning native JSON for new responses and add header `x-rw-structured-encoding: string|json`. Keep shim for 2 releases to allow SDKs to migrate. We'll also emit a telemetry metric `structured_encoding:type`.

rachael-sdk: Also found a retry-related double-encode: serializer runs before the retry dedupe and can stringify twice if a retry replays transformed payload. Moving serializer into transport layer makes it idempotent.

sam-qa: I'll add e2e permutations to sample-apps: (1) router returns string-encoded value; (2) router returns native object; (3) simulate retry replay. That should catch regressions.

rachael-sdk: I'll open a small PR with: 1) `parseJsonModeValue` helper + types, 2) `validateStructuredOutput(schema, value, {coerceStrings:false})` helper, 3) move serializer into transport to avoid double-stringify, 4) unit tests. Will default to strict (no coercion) and document `coerceStrings: true` examples in onboarding.

omar-runtime: Sounds good. I'll create runtime ticket to add header + telemetry and schedule normalization after 2 releases.

release-bot: Candidate PRs: js-sdk#1072 (parse helper + transport fix) -> staging, sample-apps#523 -> staging tests queued.

pat-devex: Action items recap: @rachael-sdk PR to export helpers + transport change; @omar-runtime add header + telemetry + deprecation plan; @sam-qa add e2e matrices and smoke test. Add a blurb in the migration guide about `json_mode` behavior and include the helper snippet.

rachael-sdk: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/js-sdk/pull/1072 — includes migration note.

pat-devex: Thanks all. Once PRs land, we'll update the quickstart snippet in sample-apps so newcomers don't hit this. :thumbsup:
